name: Beam Seating
parts: two T-legs with foot bars and floor glides
four upholstered vinyl seat pads on molded shells
four upholstered backs on shells with steel spines
three fixed armrests between seats with polyurethane pads
two hinged end arms that swing up
fold-down laminate tablet arm on the right end
style: Clinic waiting room, a few years in service: seat fronts slightly worn, arm pads scuffed.
summary: Four-seat waiting-room beam seating: steel beam on T-legs, teal vinyl seats and backs on black shells, lift-up end arms and a fold-down tablet.
